source.identifier: FMS Mercury design system — DESIGN.md, docs/MERCURY_VISUAL_STANDARD.md, docs/MERCURY_UI_CONTRACT.md, frontend/triplogger/lib/shared/mercury_tokens.dart, app_theme.dart, app_spacing.dart, lib/shared/widgets/mercury_components.dart, lib/view/mercury_shell.dart (read-only extract, no runtime assets embedded)

page.description: Page field behind content; dark form is also the map-adjacent operating canvas.

surface_raised.description: Raised controls, input fields, navigation surfaces.

accent.description: Mercury Teal — the single interaction, selection, focus, icon and progress signal. Dark form is the higher-luminance variant of the same signal.

accent_soft.description: Tonal container for selection, secondary action, status and icon-container surfaces.

divider.description: Hairline separation for grouped rows and pane boundaries.

text_on_accent.description: Foreground on accent fills (onPrimary in app_theme.dart).

disabled.description: Unavailable state — always paired with reduced opacity plus an icon, label, or semantic announcement; never color or opacity alone.

colors.authority_note: Light/dark values above are the documented semantic palette (DESIGN.md frontmatter + docs/MERCURY_VISUAL_STANDARD.md, two consistent doc sources). The shipped mercury_tokens.dart records different light values for page (#E6EBF2), surface (#EFEFF5), accent (#143633), accent_soft (#143633), divider (#B8BEC4) and dark accent (#64CBBF) — see evidence item EVID-DRIFT-1. Per the Mercury authority chain, doc values bind for new builds until the owner reconciles the drift.
colors.rule: Every semantic role must resolve deliberately in BOTH light and dark appearance (Paired Appearance Rule). Feature code consumes semantic role names, never raw hex values.

typography.weight_note: No-Bold Rule: no user-facing text above Medium (500). Hierarchy comes from role, size, spacing and tone. DESIGN.md documents Regular 400 body + Medium 500 heads/labels; the shipped app_theme.dart pins all semantic roles to w300 as an owner-approved legibility exception for field devices (EVID-DRIFT-2). New builds default to the documented 400/500; deviate only by owner decision.

display.use: Rare high-level display moments, never routine operations.

title.use: App bars, centered page headers, section hierarchy.

label.use: Buttons, navigation, field labels, chips, compact operational metadata.

typography.scale_note: Implemented as Material 3 large/medium/small variants within each role. System text scaling passes through with no application-level maximum; essential actions must remain reachable at 1x and 2x text scale.

use.compact: Tight spacing between related elements, icon padding, badge internals
use.related: Gaps between a label and its icon/value, chip vertical padding
use.control: Control-adjacent gaps, chip horizontal padding, form field spacing
use.group: Card internal padding, row content insets, divider indent
use.section: Between content sections, grid gutters at 2-3 columns

use.circular: Circular controls, icon pills, status badge silhouettes

radii.rule: Nested-Radius Rule: child controls use a tighter radius than the group containing them. Pill Has a Job Rule: full pills (999) are reserved for compact actions, status, and circular navigation — not ordinary content containers.

hairline.use: Quiet dividers between grouped rows and pane boundaries; default card border is none

status_badge_border.use: Status badge outline in the tone color over a 12% tint

flat.use: Page fields, app bars, resting structural regions

ambient_card.use: Tappable cards and grouped operational containers

decision_surface.use: Dialogs and decision surfaces rising temporarily above the workflow

floating_map_control.use: Controls requiring separation over detailed map imagery

shadows.rule: Tonal-First Rule: hierarchy is established with semantic surface levels; shadow confirms a raised role instead of inventing one. Lift With Purpose Rule: visible lift is reserved for actionable cards, decisions, and controls floating over complex content. Primary buttons render at elevation 1 (app_theme.dart); surfaceTint is transparent everywhere.

page_max_width.evidence: DESIGN.md: general page content stops stretching at 1280px; information-heavy workspaces may expand to 1440px.

responsive_card_grid.gutter: group (16) at 1 column, section (24) at 2-3 columns

alignment.page_header: Centered title, back control leading, at most one trailing action; long titles ellipsize rather than displace controls
alignment.cards: Left-aligned content; centered variant only when the card is a single focused task
alignment.dividers: Hairline, indented by group (16) inside groups

rules: Below 1024: bottom navigation; one clear task; scrollable card stacks; safe-area-aware content; controls usable without hover.
At 1024 and above: bottom navigation is replaced by an always-labeled navigation rail (NavigationRailLabelType.all observed in mercury_shell.dart) plus a 1px vertical divider before content.
Intermediate thresholds (600/720/840/900) admit horizontal filters, two-column forms, navigation rails, or master-detail panes per workflow.

Desktop is an administration/master-data workspace (persistent navigation, panes, multi-column forms); mobile is a role-filtered operational surface (current work, status, quick actions, full-bleed maps). Share tokens and product truth; do not force compositional parity.
Desktop-only administrative modules do not leave dead navigation placeholders on mobile.
One job per screen (Screen Composition Law) — see rules.md.
responsive.breakpoint_note: 600 and 1024 are observed in code (MercuryBreakpoints.compact / .expandedNavigation). The 720/840/900 intermediate thresholds are documented in DESIGN.md but were not observed as code constants — treat as guidance, not law.

card.structure: Optional accent-colored leading icon + title (title role) + optional subtitle/body-small + content + trailing chevron when tappable; optional top-right corner badge; optional bottom trailing indicator; optional loading strobe along the bottom edge
rules: Never nest a card inside a card.
One tappable surface; header may carry its own tap target when it differs from the body action.
Semantic container with a combined label; announces 'Updating.' while loading.

grouped_panel.use: One shared surface for a related stack of actionable rows; children keep their own interaction and semantics while the group owns background, radius, elevation, insets and separators.
grouped_panel.supports: Reorderable variant with the canonical 44px gutter / 7px accent rail

status_badge.rule: Every tone carries an icon and text so meaning never depends on color alone; the disabled tone appends ', disabled' to the semantic label.

corner_badge.surface: Solid tone color with on-surface (scheme.surface) icon and labelMedium text
corner_badge.use: Compact count/status ribbon integrated into the card corner; does not consume a content row and never uses a pill silhouette

metric_chip.use: Single-line tonal value chip for compact card metrics; semantic label 'value'; keep values unit-free when the unit belongs to the label.
variants_observed: inset_metric (value over label, radius control, padding related, value titleSmall w500, label bodySmall)
metric_value_row (icon + bodyMedium label + titleMedium value in a wrap)

section_header.behavior: Semantics header; optional single trailing action

centered_page_header.structure: Centered title (titleLarge); optional eyebrow (labelSmall, accent, +1.8 letter spacing); optional subtitle (labelSmall, secondary); one optional trailing action
centered_page_header.rule: Long titles ellipsize; Back and the trailing action are never displaced. Exactly one back affordance per screen.

row.trailing: chevron for navigation, switch for toggles
row.semantics: Combined label; button when tappable; toggled state exposed; ', disabled' appended when disabled

buttons.states: Material state overlays, progress indicators, disabled semantics, visible keyboard focus

input_field.border: 1px divider at rest; 2px accent on focus; error color, strengthened to 2px while focused
input_field.disabled: Lower-emphasis semantic color plus explicit unavailable state — never opacity alone

navigation.mobile: Bottom navigation for the compact set of primary destinations; stacks + system Back for hierarchy; optional unread badge (accent tonal) with accessible unread announcement
navigation.desktop: Always-labeled navigation rail; extended 260px rail for detailed administration
navigation.active_state: accent_soft tonal background with accent icon/foreground
navigation.footer_actions: Signature mobile action: 64x32 tonal icon pill above a centered compact label inside a 112-wide, min-72-high target; actions wrap as a centered group and remain understandable without the icon

state_view.structure: 40px icon, centered title (title role), message (body role), Retry filled button on error
state_view.semantics: Container with combined label; error variant is a live region

inline_notice.structure: Status badge + optional outlined retry action, wrapped
inline_notice.semantics: Live region for warning and error tones

interaction_states.focus: Visible keyboard focus via Material state overlays; 2px accent field outline
interaction_states.loading: Slim edge strobe on cards; semantics announce updating state
interaction_states.reorder: Uniform contained grabber/gutter treatment (44px gutter, 7px accent rail); surrounding page never scrolls during reorder

accent_light_vs_white_label.note: Computed from the documented #397C76; the visual standard asserts AA compliance for white action labels. The shipped dark-teal light accent (#143633) computes to roughly 13:1 — see EVID-DRIFT-1.

contrast.rule: Do not assert a numeric contrast ratio without recomputing for the exact pair in use; keep the adjusted-accent approach (preserve hue, adjust lightness to meet AA for white labels) when overriding.

accessibility.focus: Visible keyboard focus everywhere (Material state overlays, 2px accent field outlines); FocusTraversalGroup ordering — reading order for grids, ordered traversal in groups, explicit numeric focus orders where interactions are non-linear

observed: centered header reserves 64px horizontal insets around Back and trailing action

accessibility.color_independence: Status and state never rely on color alone: every status tone pairs icon + text; disabled pairs reduced emphasis with an icon, label, or semantic announcement; selected chips shift tone
accessibility.text_scaling: System text scaling passes through with no application-level maximum; essential actions must remain reachable at 1x and 2x scale; Poppins carries the branded hierarchy while native text honors user scaling
accessibility.semantics: Combined semantic labels on composite widgets ('label, value'); live regions on warnings/errors; disabled and toggled states announced; tooltips on icon-only controls (Back)

motion.reduced_motion: Reduced-motion preferences preserved (DESIGN.md); no motion token observed in code — confidence 0.5, inferred
motion.loading: Non-blocking strobe rather than modal spinners for card refresh

evidence: OBSERVED: semantic palette (light+dark) documented twice, consistently — DESIGN.md frontmatter and docs/MERCURY_VISUAL_STANDARD.md palette table (sampled from approved task #60 captures).
OBSERVED: spacing scale 4/8/12/16/24/32 identical in DESIGN.md, MERCURY_VISUAL_STANDARD.md, MercurySpacing, and AppSpacing (legacy names xs..xxxl) in app_spacing.dart.
OBSERVED: radii 8/12/20/28/999 identical in DESIGN.md and MercuryRadii (mercury_tokens.dart).
OBSERVED: elevations 0/2/3/4 with 10%/24% black ambient in DESIGN.md shadow vocabulary, matched by MercuryElevation and card theme (elevation 2, shadowColor black at 10%) in app_theme.dart.
OBSERVED: input focus 2px accent border and focused-error 2px error border in app_theme.dart inputDecorationTheme.
OBSERVED: card theme — surface color, radius 20, elevation 2, anti-aliased clip, transparent surfaceTint; app bar flat (elevation 0) with page background and centered title (app_theme.dart).
OBSERVED: buttons — primary fill padding 24x12 radius 12 elevation 1; text button padding 16x8; outlined 1px accent border (app_theme.dart).
OBSERVED: chips radius 8 with divider hairline border; selected chips use a tonal container (app_theme.dart chipTheme + DESIGN.md).
OBSERVED: status badge — five tones, pill radius, 12% tint background, 1px tone border, 18px icon, label; disabled tone appends ', disabled' (MercuryStatusBadge).
OBSERVED: metric chips — accent_soft at 42% opacity, radius 12, padding 8h/4v (MercuryMetricChip); inset metric variant adds value-over-label at radius 12 (MercuryInsetMetric).

OBSERVED: settings group — surface, radius 20, hairline dividers indented 16 (MercurySettingsGroup); settings row — minHeight 48, content padding 16h/4v, chevron or switch trailing, combined semantics (MercurySettingsRow).
OBSERVED: section header — titleLarge, 4px side / 8px bottom padding, optional trailing action, semantics header (MercurySectionHeader).

OBSERVED: centered page header — 64px height, 48px circular tonal back (filledTonal), centered titleLarge, optional eyebrow in accent with +1.8 letter spacing, 64px horizontal text insets (MercuryCenteredPageHeader, MercuryCircularBackButton).
OBSERVED: home card — surface, radius 20, elevation 2 with 10% black, 16 padding, accent icon, titleMedium title, bodySmall subtitle, chevron, corner-badge slot, loading strobe (MercuryHomeCard).

OBSERVED: grouped panel — surface, radius 20, elevation 2, hairline dividers indented 16, reorderable variant (MercuryGroupedPanel); canonical reorder gutter 44px wide with 7px accent rail (MercuryReorderGutter).
OBSERVED: responsive grid — 1 column below 600, 2 at 600, 3 at 1024; gutter 16 at 1 column else 24 (MercuryResponsiveGrid).

OBSERVED: shell — width >= 1024 renders NavigationRail with labelType all plus a 1px vertical divider; below 1024 renders a bottom NavigationBar (mercury_shell.dart ~lines 1317-1358, MercuryBreakpoints.expandedNavigation).
OBSERVED: no-bold — all user-facing weights capped at 500 (DESIGN.md, MERCURY_VISUAL_STANDARD.md, UI contract line 7).
OBSERVED: status color independence — MercuryStatusTone docstring 'Every variant also carries an icon and semantic text, so its meaning never depends on color alone.'

EVID-DRIFT-1 (flagged): shipped MercuryThemeTokens light values differ from the documented palette — page #E6EBF2 vs #EEF1F8, surface #EFEFF5 vs #F8FAFE, accent #143633 vs #397C76, accent_soft #143633 vs #CFE5E2, divider #B8BEC4 vs #D9DEE8; dark accent #64CBBF vs documented #78B8B0. app_theme.dart derives the runtime accent from base hue/saturation with fixed lightness (0.14 light, 0.59 dark), so the operative light accent is the near-black teal, not the documented Mercury Teal. Both sets are observed; which is canonical for NEW builds is an owner decision. This template binds the documented palette (authority chain: DESIGN.md + visual standard outrank implementation defaults) and requires owner reconciliation at first real use.

EVID-DRIFT-2 (flagged): app_theme.dart pins every semantic text role to FontWeight.w300 ('minimum owner-approved weight that remains legible'), below the documented 400/500 range. The No-Bold cap (never above 500) is unaffected. New builds default to the documented 400/500; the 300 baseline is an owner-approved Mercury exception, not a template default.

INFERRED (confidence 0.5): reduced-motion handling — asserted by DESIGN.md do's ('preserve reduced-motion preferences') but no motion token or MediaQuery.disableAnimations handling was observed in the extracted sources.
INFERRED (confidence 0.8): contrast ratios 4.9:1 (documented light accent vs white) and 6.7:1 (documented dark accent vs dark on-accent) computed from hex values, not measured from rendered captures.

INFERRED (confidence 0.6): intermediate breakpoints 720/840/900 documented in DESIGN.md prose but not present as code constants; treat as workflow guidance, not enforced law. The 600 and 1024 thresholds are code-observed.

NOT EXTRACTED: exact Poppins font files (vendored in Mercury under the SIL Open Font License) are not embedded here; consuming apps must supply Poppins (or accept the sans-serif fallback) and include the OFL license notice. Map-specific palettes (route option colors, congestion reds/ambers) and print-world run-sheet hex literals are owner-approved Mercury exceptions and are deliberately out of template scope.
